First check fails
$ check mobile-nav
✗ The page still scrolls horizontally

Continue after an initial failure, pause at a limit or approval boundary, and stop after acceptance checks pass.

How the application decides whether to run another round

Continue after an initial failure: If the failure is new and attempts remain, the application passes the check result into another round.

Pause at a limit or approval boundary: Two identical failures or a proposed shared-style change pauses the loop with its evidence.

Stop after real checks pass: The task ends only when the build passes and the 390px page no longer overflows.

What people often confuse

ReAct explains how new evidence changes the next action. An agent loop controls whether the application runs another round, including attempt, permission, pause, and stop conditions.

You can say this to an AI Agent

“

Fix the mobile navigation overflow. After each change, run the build and inspect the page at 390px. Allow at most two attempts for the same failure and pause before changing shared navigation styles. Finish only when both checks pass, and report why each round continued, paused, or completed.
